notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.notes:
Today we've published our largest update yet with an entirely new dungeon to explore! 7 new enemies, 17 new maps, an Overworld city with shops, plus hundreds of bug fixes and improvements!

The Cyclopean City is an ancient architectural nightmare uncovered by pilgrims far to the north -- Adventurers may travel by boat from the castle farm to discover what horrors were unveiled by these naive excavations! 

Infinite depths of terror and the abominable Shoggoth await!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35899458/8e28936190990a8915cde85d60a85b3d2a277c69.png

Join us on Discord! https://discord.gg/b9qjXEN

You can talk to the team every day, find detailed patch notes, the development roadmap, tips and hints, and a big community of players to help you get started!

notes.title: Content Update v1.0.5
notes.notes:
We've published the first content update: Trinkets, basic inventory and additional weapon slots! Also AI monsters are much less stupid!

Players can discover millions of trinkets that impart a wide variety of stats and benefits. Stack them to customize your character's damage, movement speed, jumping, and weapon specialization.

Soon you can move these trinkets to the Steam Marketplace to save, buy, and sell.

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/b9qjXEN

You'll find our development roadmap, daily dungeon tips, The Yellow King book club, plus free gifts and a sneak peak at what's coming next!
